verdicts.reason: A scatters the pieces across the tall canvas. The BEDDING wordmark is small and sits left, detached from the logo. The "& Baby Toddler" logo is tiny and floats off-axis, the image strip hovers in a different place, and the dot patterns are nearly invisible. There is no grouping or hierarchy and most of the canvas is dead space, so it is unusable. B keeps the original banner lockup (image, logo, BEDDING, dots) intact and in the right reading order, so it stays recognisably the same design. But it is just the banner shrunk into a thin strip in the middle of a tall canvas. Huge empty areas sit above and below, the text is small, the dots touch the canvas edges, and the logo crowds the image. It is still the clearly better of the two, but it is not shippable.
